title: STNFS with a ball-region sieved descent: 2^122.20601

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z for the supplied nonidentity Q with success at least 0.39 (modelled 0.3912, proof.md section 7) under heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). A global meter bounds all classical work by W <= 2^122.20601 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C=20,000 instructions; the ledger (proof.md section 8) totals 2^122.205983. Relation collection keeps the accepted frontier's 2601/2500 work and 2401/2500 yield brackets; its f-side ECM cofactor slack is 291 bits (surviving f-side cofactors bounded by 299) and its g-side slack is 222 bits (surviving g-side cofactors bounded by 230), with the per-survivor two-side ECM charged by the package's explicit ecm16.py schedule at 99% per prime (2^37.5176 and 2^37.5149 per side, 2^38.5163 per survivor including the norm and trial-division charges) instead of the predecessor's crude ECM table (2^40.06), giving retained yield 2^64.2243, which is 0.394 bits above 1.3 U and above the model's 0.30-bit feasibility floor. The descent's missing-log input is LOG2_RELS = 64.224, the floor of that same model count (the 2401/2500 yield bracket is already included); evidence16.py checks LOG2_RELS <= log2_rels (the rels_input check). The metered descent cap is 2^118.886 units, above the same plan's two-log expectation 2^118.143 (Markov abort <= 2^-0.743, exact 2^-0.743312). The certified norm-bound per-block charge is the measured marginal 1,508.2 instructions (measurements12.txt); linear algebra uses block sizes (26,5), per-entry charges 88/97 (the package's 88-instruction component sum and the measured 97-instruction bw_full loop), and the filtering/LA pad 1.61, whose charged ratio 1.61 x 0.0471 = 0.07585 still exceeds the worst measured 2^12 filtering seed ratio 0.0757. Preprocessing per instance is at most 2^122.20601 units and is included in the total; no external advice is assumed. Storage is at most 2^105 bytes. Nothing is amortized across challenges. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes the certificates, rho, pool, ledger, filtering, descent plan with retention model and ECM schedules, toys and audit; prints total_log2W_full_ledger and modelled_success.
